name: hyperresearch
description: Agent-driven research knowledge base. Agents collect, search, and synthesize web research into a persistent, searchable wiki.
one_liner: Turns your AI coding assistant into a deep-research assistant that reads dozens of sources, checks its own work, and writes a fully-cited report.
buyer: A market analyst, consultant, or grad student who currently spends days manually researching and writing reports and wants a first-draft researcher.
business_use_cases: A boutique market-research firm uses it to produce first-draft competitive analysis reports for clients faster, then has a human analyst polish them.
A consulting freelancer offers 'rapid research report' services to small businesses that can't afford traditional research firms.
A due-diligence team in a small investment fund uses it to quickly build background dossiers on potential deals.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'research report as a service' business: client sends a question, you run the pipeline and deliver a polished report.
Sell a hosted version with a nicer UI and higher rate limits to research-heavy teams.

steal_this: Take three real client research questions this weekend, run them through the pipeline, polish the outputs, and sell them as a 'rapid research' package.
